questions.stem: What is a major consequence of kidney failure if left untreated?

options.text: The lungs stop producing carbon dioxide
Toxic waste products like urea accumulate in the blood
Red blood cells are no longer made by the bone marrow

questions.explanation: When kidneys fail, they cannot filter waste products from the blood. Urea and other toxins accumulate, which can cause confusion, coma, and eventually death if untreated.
